one_line_brief: Premium editorial stationery brand meets modern digital productivity tools. Minimal + Warm + Editorial + Functional + Premium. Not Colourful + Cluttered + Generic + Over-designed.
note: This is the CANONICAL machine-readable LumiumX design foundation. It consolidates docs/LUMIUMX_ETSY_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (the brand), docs/design/COLOUR.md, docs/design/TYPOGRAPHY.md and docs/design/LAYOUT.md. Where earlier files disagreed on exact hex values, the values here win (see design/brand/LUMIUMX_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md section 'Resolved conflicts'). A product DESIGN_SPEC inherits these and overrides only with a stated reason.

rules: One accent per asset, 3-5 deliberate placements. Count before shipping; >6 is a failure.
Accent is never body text, never a currency value, never a table grid line, never a large fill.
Semantic colours exist ONLY inside the functional workbook (conditional formatting), never in marketing or print.

display.fallback: Playfair Display, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, serif

rules: Two families maximum. A reader must be able to name the register from the typeface alone.
No display line set in Inter Bold - that is the #1 tell of template design in this category.
Hierarchy from size (>=1.5x jumps), then weight (400 vs 600), then case+tracking, then space. Never colour.
Negative tracking on large display (-0.005 to -0.02em); positive tracking on small uppercase labels (0.08-0.22em); zero on body.
Start from the grid, then break it on purpose - asymmetry creates energy, dead-centred everything reads as a template.
Every asset has ONE focal point, unambiguously dominant via size + contrast + isolation.
Structure from hairline rules and whitespace, not from bordered cards. No boxes.
Hold a small number of alignment edges ruthlessly.
Vary composition and density across a listing set; keep margins, type scale, palette, kicker motif and mockup lighting constant.
Whitespace frames a focal point or separates groups - never an undesigned void between a heading and centred content.

components.kicker: Small accent mark (2px rule or a dot) + tracked UPPERCASE label. The recurring motif that ties a page/asset together.
components.section_divider: Tracked-caps label on a full-width Stone hairline. No fill.
components.hairline_table: Horizontal rules only; vertical rules only between semantically distinct column groups. Stone or ink hairline, never accent.
components.kpi_figure: Large tabular figure + small label + one hairline. No boxed tint.
components.feature_panel: One number that reads as the headline result: top accent rule + serif label + value + italic caption.
components.input_cell: Faint warm fill (#FFFDF4) distinct from calculated cells; black ink on it must clear 12:1.
components.checkbox: Square, ~4mm, 0.75pt stroke. Never circular, never accent-filled.
components.progress_strip: Hand-shaded strip; the only permitted accent fill, and only because it encodes user data.
components.brand_mark: Small 'LX' monogram or 'LUMIUMX' wordmark, one corner, quiet.
components.mockup_frame: Thin Stone border, one soft warm directional shadow, slight tilt (~-1.6deg). No browser chrome, no traffic-light dots.

avoid: generic spreadsheet appearance / looks like an Excel template
icon glyphs in tinted rounded squares
emoji, cartoon illustrations, clipart, childish visuals
rainbow palettes, excessive pastels, loud gradients, neon
fake browser chrome around a screenshot
the same block repeated down the page (heading -> card -> card -> card -> footer)
a big heading then a dead vertical gap then centred content
body copy that is a raw spec sentence with mid-word line breaks

family_accents.seasonal: one controlled seasonal accent; background and type unchanged
